answer: Agents stake a dynamic liquidity escrow whose balance decays as ember unless refreshed by unique proof-of-personhood, and each bid must mirror the escrow ledger to enter the truthful auction. Sybil clusters are detected when correlated stake timing reveals a rising tide of duplicate identities, triggering escrow slashing before collusion pays. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
